card.name: Stray footnote digits after text
card.fires_on: A lone digit such as 1 or 2 stuck onto the end of a word, number or unit, usually a footnote or superscript marker that was flattened into the text. Seen in tables, dose lists and web pages.

modes.label: Digit inside table cells
modes.description: A footnote digit sits at the end of a table header or count.
